title: Bananas & Cream Bread – MJCT’s Version
preamble:
Ingredients:-
¼
cup water and 1 tablespoon water
3
tablespoons powdered milk
1½
tablespoons sugar
1½
teaspoons salt
1½
tablespoons olive oil
2
medium sized bananas
¾
cup Greek Yogurt
3
cups bread flour
1
packet active dry yeast
¾
cup sultanas

¾

3

1
packet active dry yeast
¾
cup sultanas

Method:-
Add all ingredients except the sultanas and bake on normal bread cycle.
At the beeper add the sultanas (29 minutes after start!).
